BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.

5. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

6. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

11. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

13. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
